thread:
Priya (PM): quick sync: proposing a 'surge-sentinel' rollout pattern for priority-routing. idea: tiny steady-state cohort + sentinel tenants that exercise high QPS during warm windows. objective: catch perf regressions before broader A/B. thoughts?
Ethan (SRE): sounds good. require per-sentinel safety gates: p95 delta < 30ms for 10m OR error > 0.5% -> auto-fallback. sentinel tenants must have separate token budgets.
Ravi (Backend): implementation notes: add 'sentinel' tag on tenant assignment and a 'warm-window' schedule in flag metadata. sample flag snippet:
```
flags:
  priority_routing:
    enabled: true
    sentinels: ["t-500","t-501"]
    warm_windows: ["02:00-04:00 UTC"]
    fallback_variant: "baseline_v2"
```

Priya (PM): rollout phases: 1) 48h shadow, 2) sentinel warm windows (2 tenants, 24h), 3) small A/B (50 tenants), 4) staged regional GA. each phase has explicit rollback gates.
Maya (Sales): enterprise asks: guaranteed opt-out and a rapid re-enable SLA (2-4h) if they opt back in. can we support a paid 'fast reenable' add-on?
Ethan (SRE): we can but require runbook + on-call approval. re-enable flow: ticket -> on-call approves -> staged re-enable (1 tenant) -> monitor 30m -> full re-enable. ops-bot should require two approvers for >10k QPS tenants.
ops-bot: rule created: "sentinel-safety" -> trigger: p95_delta>30ms for 10m OR errors>0.5% for 5m. action: set flag priority_routing=false for affected tenant(s), open incident, ping @Ethan (SRE). runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sentinel-fallback
Ravi (Backend): add circuit-breaker: per-tenant concurrency cap + token-budget guard + cost-threshold pause (projected > $4k/day). will include quick curl rollback in PR.
Priya (PM): GA acceptance: autopilot fallback proven in staging, telemetry (per-tenant p50/p95, tokens/sec, fallback reason), opt-in form + customer comms, legal signoff on SLA text, runbook exercised.
Ethan (SRE): add a 'canary red button' in the console that flips global flag with audit trail. ops-bot will post heartbeat every 15m during warm windows.
Maya (Sales): I'll prepare comms + opt-in list and note which accounts want the paid fast-reenable.
Priya (PM): action items: Ravi -> flags + rollback snippet (today), Ethan -> ops-bot rule + dashboards + kill-switch (EOD), Maya -> comms + opt-in list (tomorrow). target: start sentinel windows next Tue. thanks :rocket:
